records.observation: TimeBoundingBox subclass, no overlap override. Constructors default/int/category or copy time bounds and category; copy constructors do not copy user buffer/values. initCategoryToNull clears category, sets index MIN_INT, clears buffer/values and decode flag. setCategory resets buffer/values/decode, or delegates null initialization. resolveCategory looks up unresolved valid index, marks found category used; missing lookup creates UnknownType-index STATE with next default color and width 1, inserts and marks used. Existing unused category is inserted/marked used and if unnamed receives default name/color; existing used returns true; null category with invalid index returns false. releaseCategory marks shared category unused and clears reference while retaining index. getCategory/getCategoryIndex direct. Errors accumulate lazily. setInfoBuffer retains array reference without invalidating decoded values. setInfoValueTypes allocates InfoValue per Category.InfoType, nulls values for absent/empty type list; null category leaves values untouched. setInfoValues records missing bytes/format mismatch, otherwise reads InfoValues via MixedDataInputStream over ByteArrayInputStream, closes on success; IOException prints stack and calls System.exit(1), no remaining-byte consumption check. decodeInfoBuffer sets flag BEFORE attempting decode. getInfoLength uses max(key count,value count) when category exists; getInfoKey can refresh keys; indexed key/value access checks upper bound but not negative index. InfoBox getByteSize=6+raw buffer length; IO overrides write/read ONLY category int + signed-short byte count + bytes, not inherited time bounds. Writer writes entire positive buffer without short-range validation; reader positive short allocates/readFully, nonpositive sets buffer null; readObject does not reset category, values, keys, errors or decode flag. toInfoBoxString decodes, interleaves keys/values up to max lengths and appends errors; toString adds time bounds, category object/index, same decoded display and errors.
